lines.en: The rough across the plain soon became so bad that we tried to get Bruce to drive back to the village we had come from.
lines.zh: 穿越平原的道路高低不平，开车走了不远，路面愈加崎岖。

lines.en: Even though the road was littered with boulders and pitted with holes, Bruce was not in the least perturbed .
lines.zh: 我们想劝说布鲁斯把车开回我们出发的那个村庄去。

lines.en: Glancing at his map, he informed us that the next village was a mere twenty miles away.
lines.zh: 尽管路面布满石头，坑坑洼洼，但布鲁斯却一点儿不慌乱。

lines.en: It was not that Bruce always underestimated difficulties.
lines.zh: 他瞥了一眼地图，告诉我们前面再走不到20英里就是一个村庄。

lines.en: He simply had no sense of danger at all.
lines.zh: 这并不是说布鲁斯总是低估困难，而是他压根儿没有一点儿危险感。

lines.en: No matter what the conditions were, he believed that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go.
lines.zh: 他认为不管路面情况如何，车必须以最高速度前进。

lines.en: As we bumped over eh dusty track, we swerved to avoid large boulders.
lines.zh: 我们在尘士飞扬的道路上颠簸，车子东拐西弯，以躲开那些大圆石。

lines.en: The wheels scooped up stones which hammered ominously under the car.
lines.zh: 车轮搅起的石块锤击车身，发出不祥的锤击声。

lines.en: We felt sure that sooner or later a stone would rip a hole in our petrol tank or damage the engine.
lines.zh: 我们想念迟早会飞起一个石块把油箱砸开一个窟窿，或者把发动机砸坏。

lines.en: Because of this, we kept looking back, wondering if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us.
lines.zh: 因此，我们不时地掉过头，怀疑车后是否留下了机油和汽油的痕迹。

lines.en: What a relief it was when the boulders suddenly disappeared, giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps of bushes.
lines.zh: 突然大石块不见了，前面是一片平地，唯一的障碍只有一簇簇灌木丛。

lines.en: But there was worse to come.
lines.zh: 这使我们长长地松了口气。

lines.en: Just ahead of us there was a huge fissure .
lines.zh: 但是更糟糕的事情在等着我们，离我们不远处，出现一个大裂缝。

lines.en: In response to renewed pleadings, Bruce stopped.
lines.zh: 我们再次央求布鲁斯小心，他这才把车停了下来。

lines.en: Though we all got out to examine the fissure, he remained in the car.
lines.zh: 我们纷纷下车察看那个大裂缝，他却呆在车上。

lines.en: We informed him that the fissure extended for fifty years and was tow feet wide and four feet deep.
lines.zh: 我们告诉他那个大裂缝长50码，宽2英尺，深4英尺。

lines.en: Even this had no effect.
lines.zh: 这也没有对他产生任何影响。

lines.en: Bruce went into a low gear and drove at a terrifying speed, keeping the front wheels astride the crack as he followed its zigzag course.
lines.zh: 布鲁斯挂上慢档，把两只前轮分别搁在裂缝的两边，顺着弯弯曲曲的裂缝，以发疯的速度向前开去。

lines.en: Before we had time to worry about what might happen, we were back on the plain again.
lines.zh: 我们还未来得及担心后果，车已重新开上了平地。

lines.en: Bruce consulted the map once more and told us that the village was now only fifteen miles away.
lines.zh: 布鲁斯又看了一眼地图，告诉我们那座村庄离我们只有15英里了。

lines.en: Our next obstacle was a shallow pool of water about half a mile across.
lines.zh: 下一个障碍是一片约半英里宽的浅水塘。

lines.en: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding half.
lines.zh: 布鲁斯向水塘冲去，但车开到水塘当中，嘎吱一声停住了。

lines.en: A yellow light on the dashboard flashed angrily and Bruce cheerfully announced that there was no oil in the engine!
lines.zh: 仪表盘一盏黄灯闪着刺眼的光芒，布鲁斯兴致勃勃地宣布发动机里没油了！

question.en: What was the difference between Bruce's behaviour and that of other people?
